reason: The first modality probe recognized sound in audio-only input but called the identical nonzero waveform silent when interleaved with video. Source alone does not establish whether input mapping or model behavior caused the difference.

route_definitions.interleaved_endpoint: Existing joint path: one video slot, audio interleaving enabled, endpoint-derived time grid.
route_definitions.separate: Same sampled video and waveform, separate video and audio slots, audio-in-video disabled. Diagnostic only; not assumed equivalent for synchronization.
route_definitions.interleaved_reader: Same joint path and sampled video, using the reader's reported sampling rate instead of the endpoint-derived rate, to isolate that timing variable.
route_definitions.audio_only: Same original/silent waveforms with no video; descriptive reference.
route_definitions.interleaved_endpoint_repeat: Repeat first pair after other routes in fresh conversations, no shared KV cache.

prompt: Same short audio-only description instruction as the prior modality probe; no target sound description, human labels, merge names or file paths.
tracing: Record token counts/runs, input feature hashes, and a read-only prefill hook on the text decoder to hash actual inserted audio embeddings and their position IDs. Compare hashes across routes/conditions. Preserve raw answers and failures.
interpretation: No route is admitted for quality scoring merely because it produces a plausible sound caption. Full silence/delay/repeat calibration remains required. No held-out access, default changes, production changes, model/environment updates or release actions.
